properties.description:
At QEC (QE Concrete), we do concrete differently.

We proudly serve Southwest Florida with both volumetric mixers and ready-mix trucks, giving our customers more flexibility, control, and value on every pour. Whether you're working on a residential slab, a large commercial job, or a public project that needs FDOT-approved materials, we have the equipment and expertise to get it done right.

We work with contractors, builders, and homeowners — providing quality service, technical guidance, and trustworthy solutions on every job. Whether it’s your first pour or your hundredth, QEC is here to help.

properties.name: QE Solar
properties.description:
QE Solar is one of the nation's largest independent solar and BESS operations and maintenance providers, with over 15 years of operating experience. We manage 10 GW of solar and 7.5 GWh of BESS across 44 states, supporting asset owners with multi-hundred MW utility solar projects and large standalone BESS systems.
 
We're pure-play O&M. That focus means our entire organization is built around one thing: keeping solar and storage assets running well. Our technicians carry broad OEM certifications, and our in-house capabilities span MV/HV electrical, vegetation management, engineering, and capital improvements, to streamline asset management for project owners.
 
Reach out if you're looking for a long-term O&M partner for your solar or storage assets.
